fields.System.Title: INT-404 — Order cycle time
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see how long orders take from arrival to dispatch, so
that I know where time is lost and whether we are meeting our promise.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then average and 95th-percentile time from order received to
  • dispatched is shown.
  • - Given the report, then it breaks the total into stages: waiting to allocate, waiting
  • to wave, picking, packing, waiting to ship.
  • - Given the stage breakdown, then the slowest stage is identifiable without manual
  • arithmetic.
  • - Given the on-time-dispatch target, then the proportion shipped before the promised
  • cut-off is shown.
  • - Given orders still open, then they are shown as in-progress with their current age.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, outbound |
| Tables | throughput projection, order, shipment |
| Risks | Aggregate query over all order history degrading ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
